verdict.rationale: Helicone only touches this story indirectly. It offers bulk read and query access across many logged requests, via the POST /v1/request/query REST endpoint, HQL (its query language) and SQL access to ClickHouse noted by the community. It can also export request data to PostHog in one line. None of the evidence shows true bulk operations that act on many items at once, so this is minimal, glancing support. Missing for 10: documented bulk mutation actions (batch tagging, scoring, deleting or updating requests), bulk dataset or prompt operations, batch API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
